headline: Nvidia shares fall after the Jensen Huang affair
dek: The market reacted to the board's investigation, per Fortune.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Drop at the open
body: Nvidia shares fell when markets reopened, after Jensen Huang admitted an affair with an executive that US intelligence officials describe as a suspected spy, per Fortune and TechRadar.
The board opened an independent investigation.

points.t: About 3.5% down on weekend pricing platforms (Fortune).
About 5% down in New York trading (TechRadar).
The analyst tied the drop to the internal probe (Fortune).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: A rough month
body: Nvidia and other AI firms were coming off an estimated $2.5 trillion sell-off, per Fortune.
Before this episode, the stock was already down for the month.

items.t: Keeps confidence in Huang and the team (Fortune).
Asked for a closed-door meeting with Huang (Fortune).

caption.hook: Nvidia shares fell when markets reopened, after the Jensen Huang affair.
body: Per Fortune, Deutsche Bank analyst Jim Reid saw a drop of about 3.5% on platforms that price stocks over the weekend and tied it to the internal investigation into Huang. TechRadar reported a drop of about 5% in New York pre-market trading. The figures come from different trading windows.

Nvidia and other AI firms were coming off an estimated $2.5 trillion sell-off the week before, and the stock was down 18.6% for the month. The board says it keeps confidence in Huang and the leadership team, and Congress asked for a closed-door meeting with him. TechRadar notes the company has no obvious successor.
caption.cta: Is Nvidia too dependent on one leader?
